name: next-platform-starter
description: 🌐 Build powerful apps with Next.js 16 and Netlify Core Primitives for seamless deployments and optimal performance.

paragraphs: next-platform-starter is a minimalistic static site generator powered by Vue. It helps users create simple yet beautiful websites without needing in-depth technical skills. Ideal for personal portfolios, blogs, or project showcases, this tool combines ease of use with powerful features.
features: User-Friendly Interface: Quickly navigate through the setup without any complicated instructions.
Customizable Templates: Use pre-built templates to get started quickly and personalize them as needed.
Minimal Dependencies: The application requires minimal libraries, ensuring quick load times and easy management.
Responsive Design: Your site will look good on both mobile devices and desktop screens.
Markdown Support: Write your content in markdown format for easy editing.
